deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for oversight and keeping advanced chips out of adversary hands.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly criticizes unmonitored chip imports by China and calls for keeping technologies from adversaries.

export_controls.text:
I'm calling on Congressional leadership of both parties to hold AI safety hearings immediately. We need responsible policy that helps us compete with China while setting the global standard for commonsense guardrails on AI development and transparency. This can’t wait.

And, I'm pushing the Trump Admin. to restore and strengthen chip export controls that stop our adversaries from using American technology against us. I advocated for these controls to protect our national security, Trump should never have rolled them back. (2/3)

china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial Intelligence has the potential to profoundly change many aspects of our lives. As AI grows into an important tool for our national security, and a driver of economic growth, comprehensive public awareness and oversight is increasingly important. The commission proposed in this bill will provide guidance on how we cultivate AI to help ensure we stay ahead of countries like China in this space, while also building guardrails to make certain the U.S. government responsibly uses AI.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the commission should help the US stay ahead of China in AI.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses staying ahead of China as a goal, though it does not frame a safety-speed tradeoff.
